channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider France (businessinsider.fr)

item.title: Kavanaugh in dissent: Bad policy or not, Trump's tariffs were 'clearly lawful'
item.description: Justices Kavanaugh, Alito, and Thomas argued that Trump's tariffs were lawful and that reversing them could get messy.

item.title: After a breakup, I put my belongings in storage and traveled full-time for 3 years. It was the best chapter of my life.
item.description: I traveled the world as a digital nomad in places like Mexico City and Paris after a breakup. The experience taught me about my own resilience.

item.title: NATO is deploying a drone carrier to its eastern edge after repeated Russian airspace incursions
item.description: TCG Anadolu is the latest asset to deploy to NATO's eastern edge as part of the ongoing Eastern Sentry operation.

item.title: Peacock's next growth bet: selling subscriptions for other streamers
item.description: Peacock has approached specialty streamers about selling subscriptions to complement its reality TV and sports-heavy programming.

item.title: The battle over Trump tariff refunds is next — and it will be messy
item.description: The process for IEEPA tariff refunds will likely go through the Court of International Trade. Already, over 1,000 lawsuits are pending.

item.title: OpenAI just hired back another employee from Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab
item.description: Thinking Machines Lab faces departures as employees rejoin OpenAI amid poaching efforts by major tech firms.

item.title: Microsoft just named Asha Sharma as its new Xbox CEO. Read the memos.
item.description: Microsoft named Asha Sharma, an executive in its CoreAI group, as Phil Spencer's replacement as the CEO of Microsoft Gaming.

item.title: The battle over Scott Adams' AI afterlife
item.description: Dilbert cartoonist Scott Adams was turned into an AI avatar after his death — and his family hates it, saying on social media, "this is not an honor."

item.title: Democrats demand that Trump issue $1,700 tariff refunds to Americans after the Supreme Court ruling
item.description: Govs. Gavin Newsom and JB Pritzker demand Trump pay Americans $1,700 in tariff refunds after the Supreme Court ruling.

item.title: All the warships, planes, and missile systems the US military is sending toward Iran
item.description: The US is mounting its largest military buildup in the Middle East since 2003. Here's a list of the weapons and hardware that it's sent to the region
